#### What type of PR is this?

/kind bug


#### What this PR does / why we need it:

There were four issues in OpenAPI aggregation cleanup:
1. When removing an APIService, openAPIAggregationController was called twice while openAPIV3AggregationController was never called, leading to OpenAPI v3 for the APIService not cleaned up.
2. When removing a local APIService, v2 specAggregator should not return ErrAPIServiceNotFound when it doesn't find the APIService because local APIServices were never added to its cache, otherwise confusing error logs would be generated. Besides, the method's comment indicates that the desired behavior is that no error is returned if the APIService does not exist.
3. When removing an APIService, v3 specProxier should update openapiv2converter's cache, like when updating an APIService, otherwise the API would not be removed from "/openapi/v3".
4. When v3 AggregationController reconciles an APIService, it should stop requeueing it if it fails with ErrAPIServiceNotFound as the APIService has been removed, like what v2 AggregationController does, otherwise it would keep reconciling the APIService forever.

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

Fixes #120107

issue_context.title: kube-apiserver doesn't clean up OpenAPI properly after deleting an APIService/CRD
issue_context.body:
### What happened?

I noticed some odd behaviors/logs after deleting APIServices and CRDs.

First, only CRDs were removed from the response of `/openapi/v3` and APIServices were not removed. Not only the root path, the APIService's specific paths were also available, e.g. `/openapi/v3/apis/foo.bar.com/v1alpha1`, as if they were not deleted.

Second, there were some confusing logs in kube-apiserver, indicating it failed to do some cleanup, and every failure was duplicated once:
```
E0822 15:24:36.314675       1 controller.go:159] removing "v1alpha1.crd.antrea.io" from AggregationController failed with: resource not found
E0822 15:24:36.314705       1 controller.go:159] removing "v1alpha1.crd.antrea.io" from AggregationController failed with: resource not found
E0822 15:24:36.316316       1 controller.go:159] removing "v1beta1.crd.antrea.io" from AggregationController failed with: resource not found
E0822 15:24:36.317664       1 controller.go:159] removing "v1beta1.crd.antrea.io" from AggregationController failed with: resource not found
```

After checking the code, I found the above observations were caused by the same code in kube-apiserver which didn't handle the removal of APIService correctly:
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/aa8cb97f65fe1d24e96eda129337d86109615570/staging/src/k8s.io/kube-aggregator/pkg/apiserver/apiserver.go#L563-L568

Basically apiserver was calling wrong AggregationController when removing APIService, which caused OpenAPI v3 not cleaned up and the duplicate errors. There was another issue in v2 AggregationController which caused the error. 

Besides, just correcting L567 didn't fix the problem totally, there were some other issues in the implementation.

### What did you expect to happen?

kube-apiserver should clean up OpenAPI correctly, shoud not generate confusing errors.

### How can we reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)?

Install some APIServices and CRDs and remove all of them, then check the response of "/openapi/v3" and kube-apiserver logs.

### Anything else we need to know?

_No response_
